newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Flooding worries weaken Czech crown.
newsitem.headline: Flooding worries weaken Czech crown.

text.p: 0700 GMT - Czech crown weakens sharply following attacks on the currency from London, spurred in part by fears of the economic costs of major flooding in the north and eastern parts of the country.
*Crown opens near 18.8 against the mark, but quickly falls to about 18.96 where it then steadies.
*"It's very difficult to defend these attacks from London investment banks. But this was really no surprise, we were waiting for this given yesterday's activity," said Tomas Becvar of Komercni Banka.
"We could see the market try to break the 19 level against the mark, but this also depends on the Czech central bank and whether it takes any action," he added.
*Dealers said they had not seen the central bank in the market yet.
